FROM MY HEART

A letter for you

For you, Ammu ♥
♥🔒
AM

I don't know how much happiness I have brought into your life, but you have given me so much. If I have to list everything I have received from you, it starts with your love and your friendship. 🥹❤️

Honestly, I feel really lucky to have you in my life. You never stopped me from being myself or from having my own freedom, and I feel extremely lucky for that. I know I don't even deserve someone as understanding as you. 🥹

I have more girl friends than boy friends, and for that, I feel really grateful to you. Even in our class, I talk to girls more than boys, but you have never put any restrictions on me or made me feel uncomfortable about it. 🫶 Thank you for trusting me and loving me this much. 💖

And now, there are hardly 3–4 months left before all of this changes. After that, I know I'm going to miss you so much. We have been together for almost 4 years, and I've become so emotionally attached to you. Just thinking about having to be away from you already hurts. 🥹😭

And honestly, I think I'm going to miss my girl-friends' circle even more than my boys' circle. There are so many memories connected to all of this, and just thinking about leaving everything behind feels really strange and painful. 🥹

Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for being everything to me and for always being there for me. ❤️‍🩹

Anyway, I promise that I won't be just a passing cloud in your life. I'll always be your friend, your best friend, and a good lover. 💖 I'll always be there beside you and remain a constant part of your life. ❤️‍🩹

Last but not least… 💖

Happiest Birthday, daw Ammu! 😘🫂🫀

Enjoy your life to the fullest, thangooo. ❤️

I'm always with you and always there for you, just the way you want me to be. 💖

♥
